nodes.label: IsGmailAddress Validator
nodes.rationale: Single reusable class-validator custom decorator added once and used in two places (this feature's request DTO + retrofitted onto the Enrollment Portal's personal_email), so the Gmail regex is never duplicated across places.

nodes.label: enrollment-session.guard.ts Session Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Existing Enrollment Portal session mechanism (guard + decorator) to be reused verbatim: token issued after OTP verify, scoped to a short-lived 2-hour token, checked by a guard on later requests. Explicitly not rebuilt.

nodes.label: RequestDetailDialog Review UI
nodes.rationale: Extend the existing RequestDetailDialog.tsx rather than build a parallel detail view; adds per-field flagging interface submitting the fieldNotes object Phase 3's endpoint expects; needs_revision status gets a distinct status badge.

nodes.label: ConcernMessage Model
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the existing MeetingChatMessage pattern - denormalized sender info, no separate thread table.

nodes.label: OrgConcernSetting Model
nodes.rationale: One-row-per-org shape matching OrgEnrollmentSetting/OrgHolidayConfig; tracks last_digest_sent_at for the digest window.

nodes.label: concern-core Shared Module
nodes.rationale: New backend/src/modules/concern/ split the way grade/ splits into core/educator/student: concern-core holds shared logic (category lookups, concern/message creation helper, the flip resolved->open rule) so student and staff reply paths reuse it instead of duplicating.

nodes.label: concern-digest BullMQ Queue
nodes.rationale: jobId collision (concern-digest-{orgId}, delay 60s) IS the entire debounce mechanism - do not add extra locking/counting logic. Mail-sending loop wrapped in per-recipient try/catch so one bad address cannot block others or fail the job.

nodes.label: sendConcernDigestEmail
nodes.rationale: Count-only body ('You have {count} new concern(s)') matching the visual template style of sendOtpEmail/sendCredentialsEmail; never includes concern content.

nodes.label: ConcernCenterFeature Component
nodes.rationale: Reusable shared component (submit form + category dropdown + my-concerns list + thread view) mounted at student/concerns only this pass but written with no hardcoded student-specific imports - accepts data/callbacks via props so an educator mount later needs no modification.

nodes.label: enrollment-registrar Module
nodes.rationale: backend/src/modules/enrollment-portal/registrar/ with controller/service/repository + dto; reuses the existing student.repository.ts pagination shape and the existing role.guard.ts (no second implementation). Endpoints: periods CRUD (delete guarded against referenced applications) and applications search/approve/reject/unlock, each producing exactly one AuditLog entry.

nodes.label: @Registrar() / REGISTRAR_KEY Decorator
nodes.rationale: Composed into the existing role.guard.ts: honors REGISTRAR_KEY requiring user.is_registrar === true alongside the role check. is_registrar already existed on Account but not on req.user - wired through jwt.strategy. Registrar gating via the guard, not inline.

nodes.label: EnrollmentApplication Model
nodes.rationale: Applicant submission: identity (personal email), entered data, program/course/level selection, random 4-char application code (friendly lookup token, not cryptographically strong), status lifecycle pending -> locked -> approved or pending/locked -> rejected -> pending on resubmit.

nodes.label: EnrollmentPeriod Model
nodes.rationale: The window concept: org, school year, start/end/lock dates, and the shareable token (/enroll/{org-slug}/{period-token}). An org can have multiple periods open at once; dates entirely at admin discretion.

nodes.label: Account.is_registrar
nodes.rationale: Registrar-level admin permission beyond the role enum; meaningful only when role=admin; additive boolean so existing accounts are unaffected.

nodes.label: Otp.purpose Enum
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes org_registration vs enrollment_verification OTPs; additive with nullable org_id so the existing auth flow is unaffected (defaults to org_registration).

nodes.label: Section.order_index
nodes.rationale: Deterministic section fill order so approval walks sections in order and stops at the first with remaining capacity; additive defaultValue(0) so all 1331 existing sections and db.section.create() callers are unaffected.

nodes.label: Organization.slug
nodes.rationale: Public-safe org identifier for the portal link; added nullable deliberately (deviation) because OrganizationService.create does not supply a slug - a non-null field would break org creation; later phase assigns slugs when enabling the portal.

nodes.label: Two-Hour Application Session
nodes.rationale: Time-limited session instead of one-shot submission, matching the Enrollment Portal UX standard; explicit decision to reuse the existing enrollment-session.guard.ts / enrollment-session.decorator.ts mechanism rather than rebuild it.

nodes.label: Admin Account Request Feature
nodes.rationale: Upgrade of the existing registration-request flow (Otp, RegistrationRequest, platform-registration module, AuthService.register/verifyOtp, AuthRepository.createAccount), not a new parallel system; reusing existing logic and avoiding duplication is the stated failure mode.

nodes.label: Three Review Outcomes
nodes.rationale: Three outcomes on review: approve (creates account, emails credentials), reject (emails a rejection notice), request-revision (emails a notice + flags specific fields; applicant sees ! markers on next Gmail-lookup access).

nodes.label: RegistrationRequest.revision_notes
nodes.rationale: Json? of shape {[fieldName]: string}, cleared entirely on resubmission; reviewed_by/reviewed_at added only if not already present under different names.

nodes.label: Platform Owner Review Actions
nodes.rationale: Approve (generates login email, creates Organization + Account role=admin + Profile.personal_email, sets reviewed_by/reviewed_at), reject (reason optional), request-revision (validates each fieldNotes key against actual RegistrationRequest fields). Plaintext password never persisted.

nodes.label: Admin Request Notification Emails
nodes.rationale: Credentials/rejection/revision-needed emails all go to the request's Gmail, never to the generated login email (not a real inbox). Credentials template must display the generated login email while being addressed to the personal Gmail.

nodes.label: Public Request Three-Step Form Flow
nodes.rationale: Step 1 Gmail input + client-side format check, Step 2 OTP verify, Step 3 fresh form or edit mode pre-filled with '!' markers next to revision_notes fields; session countdown prompts re-verify on lapse rather than a silent submit failure.

nodes.label: Concern Center Feature
nodes.rationale: Student-facing feature for submitting concerns (account problem, grade problem, etc.) with in-app threaded replies and a shared admin/registrar inbox. Educator support explicitly out of scope this pass - backend stays role-generic (sender_role on Concern) so adding educator later is a nav link + component reuse, not new backend work.

nodes.label: Default Category Seeding
nodes.rationale: Four default ConcernCategory rows (Account Problem, Grade Problem, Technical Issue, Other) all is_default:true, seeded on org creation into the exact same hook that creates OrgEnrollmentSetting/OrgHolidayConfig - not a new/parallel seeding path.

nodes.label: Student Concern Endpoints
nodes.rationale: GET /concerns/categories, POST /concerns (Concern + first ConcernMessage in one transaction, notify all org admins/registrars via createBulkNotifications - a single batch call, not a loop), GET /concerns/mine, GET /concerns/:id, POST /concerns/:id/reply. Ownership-checked (403). Only brand-new concerns trigger the digest, never replies.

nodes.label: Admin/Registrar Shared Inbox Endpoints
nodes.rationale: No claiming/assignment - any role=admin account (registrar-flagged or not) can act on anything. Staff reply reuses concern-core message-creation helper and notifies only the original sender in-app (no email, no digest). Category deactivation only, no hard delete; categories with is_default:true deactivated but not deletable.

nodes.label: registrarVisible Nav-Scoping Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Per-item registrarVisible flag in the AdminSidebar nav config (built during Registrar Portal phases); @Roles('admin') naturally covers registrar accounts since their role field stays 'admin' - no isRegistrar-specific gating, per the project's UI-only registrar enforcement decision.

nodes.label: Application Approval (Account+Profile+SSY+SPE Creation)
nodes.rationale: Approval triggers the existing enrollment-creation logic to produce Account + Profile + StudentSchoolYear + StudentProgramEnrollment; section auto-assigned in fill order; credentials emailed to personal email (the only notification target pre-account); approved is terminal.

nodes.label: Anonymous OTP-Verified Applicant
nodes.rationale: Anonymous visitor, no account, identified only by a personal email verified via OTP each visit; never logs in with a password until approved. One application per email per org per school year (unique constraint) - OTP verify doubles as the do-you-already-have-an-application check.

nodes.label: Public Enrollment Portal
nodes.rationale: A public unauthenticated intake portal that lets a prospective student apply without an account and a registrar review/approve into real student accounts. Not a new enrollment system - a new front door that on approval produces exactly the same Account+Profile+StudentSchoolYear+StudentProgramEnrollment records a registrar creates manually today. Reuse-not-reimplementation is the single most important constraint.

nodes.label: Application Lifecycle (pending>locked>approved)
nodes.rationale: Approval is terminal, rejection is not. Locking is time-based and automatic (scheduler sweep) but reversible by a human (registrar manual unlock). Section is never applicant-chosen - auto-assigned by a defined fill order (added Section.order_index). Gap between lock_date and end_date gives registrars a stable batch while latecomers can still apply.

nodes.label: Registrar Actor
nodes.rationale: An Account with role=admin and is_registrar=true. Reviews, approves, rejects, and manually unlocks applications; same person who does manual enrollment today, just with a new queue.

nodes.label: Auto-Reopen on Sender Reply

nodes.label: Rate-Limited Email Digest
nodes.rationale: BullMQ delayed job with a deterministic per-org jobId (concern-digest-{orgId}) gives debouncing for free - no manual counters or locks. Count-only emails, never message content. last_digest_sent_at always updated regardless of mail success/failure so a persistent mail outage cannot double-count into the next window; created_at > last_digest_sent_at (not >=) avoids boundary off-by-one.
